headline: [Heartbreaking!] WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at [Age 38]
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Heartbreaking! WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at Age 38

WWE star Bronson Reed, whose real name was Jermaine Haley, has died at the age of 38. WWE announced on Friday that he died due to "medical complications" and did not give more details.

🔹 Reed was born in Adelaide, South Australia. He made his WWE main roster debut in 2022, won the Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal in 2024 and was a former NXT North American champion.
🔹 His last WWE appearance was at the Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia earlier this month, in a match against Oba Femi.
🔹 WWE called him "a larger-than-life figure" and "a devoted family man." He is survived by his pregnant wife, Paige, and their daughter.

💬 What is your favourite Bronson Reed moment? 👇

Sources: ESPN, ABC News, WWE statement

headline: [El Niño Strikes!] Floods Hit Peru and Ecuador, [34 Dead] in Ecuador
caption:
🌊 El Niño Strikes! Floods Hit Peru and Ecuador, 34 Dead in Ecuador

Heavy rains linked to a very strong El Niño flooded cities in Peru and Ecuador on Friday. In Piura, northern Peru, water rose to waist height in the streets after 12 hours of heavy rain, AFP reported. Ecuador's risk management agency said 34 people have died and 47,000 have been affected across the country.

🔹 About 2,000 families were affected in Piura, according to preliminary reports from Peru's civil defence chief. Flooding forced patients at a Piura hospital to move to its auditorium.
🔹 In Manta, Ecuador, two rivers broke their banks and residents waded through chest-deep water.
🔹 Peru's President Keiko Fujimori postponed a trip to Colombia because of the crisis. Peru's weather service warned more heavy rain could fall over the next four days.

💬 Is your country ready for extreme weather like this? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, AFP
